| Asset | Version | License | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| Leaflet (leaflet.js, leaflet.css, layers*.png) | 1.9.4 | BSD-2-Clause | https://leafletjs.com / npm `leaflet` |
| Bricolage Grotesque (variable, latin) | 5.3.0 | SIL OFL 1.1 | npm `@fontsource-variable/bricolage-grotesque` (Mathieu Triay et al.) |
| Atkinson Hyperlegible (400, 700, latin) | 5.3.0 | SIL OFL 1.1 | npm `@fontsource/atkinson-hyperlegible` (Braille Institute of America) |
